blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style wooden sentry box or guard booth. It features an open arched entrance in front, raised wooden plank flooring, and three enclosed walls decorated with red and off-white diagonal stripes and diamond-shaped peepholes/windows with timber frames. Heavy timber framing reinforces the corners and midsections. The gabled roof is made of wooden planks along a central ridge cap, crowned with a spherical wooden finial at the front apex.
blind.from_above: A rectangular pitched wooden roof with visible longitudinal planks sloping down to either side from a central ridge beam, with a round wooden ball finial at one gable peak and a square cap at the other.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 ft 6 in tall to the ball finial (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 3 ft wide by 3 ft deep.
